# TechFi Labs

> TechFi Labs builds AI agents, workflow automations, Salesforce workflows, and custom tools that reduce manual work for business teams.

Canonical website: https://www.techfilabs.com
Contact: https://www.techfilabs.com/contact

## Company

- Name: TechFi Labs
- Location: Jaipur, Rajasthan, India
- Services: AI automation, workflow automation, Salesforce delivery, data migration, mobile applications, and web applications
- Email: contact.team@techfilabs.com
- Phone: +91 79761 11087

## Existing service pages

- [Services](https://www.techfilabs.com/services): Current AI automation, Salesforce, mobile, and web delivery services.
- [AI Agents and Automation](https://www.techfilabs.com/services/ai-agents-automation): AI-assisted workflows for repetitive sales, support, and operational tasks.
- [WhatsApp Automation](https://www.techfilabs.com/services/whatsapp-automation-solutions): WhatsApp workflows for customer communication, lead handling, and CRM integration.
- [Salesforce Consulting](https://www.techfilabs.com/services/salesforce-consulting): Salesforce setup, customization, automation, integrations, and optimization.
- [Salesforce Data Migration](https://www.techfilabs.com/services/salesforce-data-migration): Mapping, cleansing, transformation, deduplication, migration, and validation support.
- [Mobile App Development](https://www.techfilabs.com/services/mobile-app-development): Android, iOS, and cross-platform application delivery.
- [Web Application Development](https://www.techfilabs.com/services/web-application-development): Websites and web applications with frontend, backend, and integration support.

## Existing products

- [Products](https://www.techfilabs.com/products): TechFi Labs products and software accelerators.
- [FieldLens for Salesforce](https://www.techfilabs.com/products/fieldlens-for-salesforce): Chrome extension for Salesforce field impact and dependency analysis.
- [Sentinel Society Management](https://www.techfilabs.com/products/sentinel-society-management): Android application for gated-community entry, communication, and daily operations.
- [RangManch AI](https://www.techfilabs.com/products/rangmanch-ai): Beta AI creator platform for videos, visuals, and digital content workflows.
- [OpsFlow Control Center](https://www.techfilabs.com/products/opsflow-control-center): Planned web console for distributed operations, service SLAs, and incident visibility.
- [SalesPilot AI](https://www.techfilabs.com/products/salespilot-ai): AI sales workflow product currently in development.
